_comment: Machine profiles. Bandwidths are MEASURED, not spec-sheet, wherever possible.
Run bench/roofline.py on a new machine and paste its numbers in as a new entry.
dram_gbps  : peak multi-threaded streaming read, GB/s
disk_gbps  : random read at expert-block granularity, saturated queue depth, GB/s
kernel_gbps: rate the SIMD dequant+GEMV kernel can consume PACKED weight bytes.
This is a ceiling independent of where the bytes came from.
free_disk_gb: space available to store the quantized model

laptop-i5-8350u.label: Work laptop - i5-8350U, 8GB single-channel DDR4-2400, SATA SSD
laptop-i5-8350u.kernel_gbps_note: estimate: 4 cores AVX2, no VNNI. Replace once the real kernel is benchmarked.

server-32gb-nvme.label: Server laptop - 32GB dual-channel DDR4-3200, Gen4 NVMe, 900GB free
server-32gb-nvme.dram_gbps_note: 51.2 theoretical x 0.80 efficiency observed on the laptop. VERIFY with roofline.py.
server-32gb-nvme.disk_gbps_note: Gen4 x4 rated 7.0 sequential; 5.5 assumed for large random reads at QD8+. VERIFY.
server-32gb-nvme.kernel_gbps_note: estimate: 8 cores. Raise if the CPU has AVX-512/VNNI.
